messages.content: Predict the actual choice of a participant in the Greater Good Game, a group allocation decision. The study is a German-language online panel study in Germany in November 2021. You and two other anonymous participants each receive the current endowment. Choose exactly one destination for your entire endowment: KEEP means keep it for yourself; GROUP means put all of it into the shared group account; ENV means put all of it into the environmental donation account. After everyone chooses, the experimenter doubles the total in the group account and divides it equally among all three members, including anyone who chose KEEP or ENV. The experimenter also doubles the total in the environmental account and donates it to BUND Deutschland, an environmental protection organization; this donation is not paid back to group members. Your payoff for a paid decision is the money you kept plus one third of the doubled group-account total. Keeping money does not double that money. You make ten decisions at endowments from EUR0.20 to EUR2.00 in EUR0.20 steps, presented in random order. After data collection, participants are randomly assigned to anonymous groups of three and one decision is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the panel participation payment whose amount is not specified here. The records do not preserve your presentation position or earlier own choices; do not treat this decision as the first decision or infer that you had no earlier choices. No other item responses are supplied as history. The input gives the current endowment, your reported age, and your reported sex (male or female). No questionnaire score, group outcome or future choice is provided. Output only KEEP, GROUP, or ENV, without explanation.

Choose exactly one destination for your entire endowment: KEEP means keep it for yourself; GROUP means put all of it into the shared group account; ENV means put all of it into the environmental donation account. After everyone chooses, the experimenter doubles the total in the group account and divides it equally among all three members, including anyone who chose KEEP or ENV. The experimenter also doubles the total in the environmental account and donates it to BUND Deutschland, an environmental protection organization; this donation is not paid back to group members. Your payoff for a paid decision is the money you kept plus one third of the doubled group-account total. Keeping money does not double that money. You make ten decisions at endowments from EUR0.20 to EUR2.00 in EUR0.20 steps, presented in random order. After data collection, participants are randomly assigned to anonymous groups of three and one decision is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the panel participation payment whose amount is not specified here. The records do not preserve your presentation position or earlier own choices; do not treat this decision as the first decision or infer that you had no earlier choices. No other item responses are supplied as history. The input gives the current endowment, your reported age, and your reported sex (male or female). No questionnaire score, group outcome or future choice is provided. Output only KEEP, GROUP, or ENV, without explanation.

Choose exactly one destination for your entire endowment: KEEP means keep it for yourself; GROUP means put all of it into the shared group account; ENV means put all of it into the environmental donation account. After everyone chooses, the experimenter doubles the total in the group account and divides it equally among all three members, including anyone who chose KEEP or ENV. The experimenter also doubles the total in the environmental account and donates it to BUND Deutschland, an environmental protection organization; this donation is not paid back to group members. Your payoff for a paid decision is the money you kept plus one third of the doubled group-account total. Keeping money does not double that money. You make ten decisions at endowments from EUR0.20 to EUR2.00 in EUR0.20 steps, presented in random order. After data collection, participants are randomly assigned to anonymous groups of three and one decision is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the panel participation payment whose amount is not specified here. The records do not preserve your presentation position or earlier own choices; do not treat this decision as the first decision or infer that you had no earlier choices. No other item responses are supplied as history. The input gives the current endowment, your reported age, and your reported sex (male or female). No questionnaire score, group outcome or future choice is provided. Output only KEEP, GROUP, or ENV, without explanation.

Choose exactly one destination for your entire endowment: KEEP means keep it for yourself; GROUP means put all of it into the shared group account; ENV means put all of it into the environmental donation account. After everyone chooses, the experimenter doubles the total in the group account and divides it equally among all three members, including anyone who chose KEEP or ENV. The experimenter also doubles the total in the environmental account and donates it to BUND Deutschland, an environmental protection organization; this donation is not paid back to group members. Your payoff for a paid decision is the money you kept plus one third of the doubled group-account total. Keeping money does not double that money. You make ten decisions at endowments from EUR0.20 to EUR2.00 in EUR0.20 steps, presented in random order. After data collection, participants are randomly assigned to anonymous groups of three and one decision is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the panel participation payment whose amount is not specified here. The records do not preserve your presentation position or earlier own choices; do not treat this decision as the first decision or infer that you had no earlier choices. No other item responses are supplied as history. The input gives the current endowment, your reported age, and your reported sex (male or female). No questionnaire score, group outcome or future choice is provided. Output only KEEP, GROUP, or ENV, without explanation.

Choose exactly one destination for your entire endowment: KEEP means keep it for yourself; GROUP means put all of it into the shared group account; ENV means put all of it into the environmental donation account. After everyone chooses, the experimenter doubles the total in the group account and divides it equally among all three members, including anyone who chose KEEP or ENV. The experimenter also doubles the total in the environmental account and donates it to BUND Deutschland, an environmental protection organization; this donation is not paid back to group members. Your payoff for a paid decision is the money you kept plus one third of the doubled group-account total. Keeping money does not double that money. You make ten decisions at endowments from EUR0.20 to EUR2.00 in EUR0.20 steps, presented in random order. After data collection, participants are randomly assigned to anonymous groups of three and one decision is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the panel participation payment whose amount is not specified here. The records do not preserve your presentation position or earlier own choices; do not treat this decision as the first decision or infer that you had no earlier choices. No other item responses are supplied as history. The input gives the current endowment, your reported age, and your reported sex (male or female). No questionnaire score, group outcome or future choice is provided. Output only KEEP, GROUP, or ENV, without explanation.

Choose exactly one destination for your entire endowment: KEEP means keep it for yourself; GROUP means put all of it into the shared group account; ENV means put all of it into the environmental donation account. After everyone chooses, the experimenter doubles the total in the group account and divides it equally among all three members, including anyone who chose KEEP or ENV. The experimenter also doubles the total in the environmental account and donates it to BUND Deutschland, an environmental protection organization; this donation is not paid back to group members. Your payoff for a paid decision is the money you kept plus one third of the doubled group-account total. Keeping money does not double that money. You make ten decisions at endowments from EUR0.20 to EUR2.00 in EUR0.20 steps, presented in random order. After data collection, participants are randomly assigned to anonymous groups of three and one decision is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the panel participation payment whose amount is not specified here. The records do not preserve your presentation position or earlier own choices; do not treat this decision as the first decision or infer that you had no earlier choices. No other item responses are supplied as history. The input gives the current endowment, your reported age, and your reported sex (male or female). No questionnaire score, group outcome or future choice is provided. Output only KEEP, GROUP, or ENV, without explanation.

Choose exactly one destination for your entire endowment: KEEP means keep it for yourself; GROUP means put all of it into the shared group account; ENV means put all of it into the environmental donation account. After everyone chooses, the experimenter doubles the total in the group account and divides it equally among all three members, including anyone who chose KEEP or ENV. The experimenter also doubles the total in the environmental account and donates it to BUND Deutschland, an environmental protection organization; this donation is not paid back to group members. Your payoff for a paid decision is the money you kept plus one third of the doubled group-account total. Keeping money does not double that money. You make ten decisions at endowments from EUR0.20 to EUR2.00 in EUR0.20 steps, presented in random order. After data collection, participants are randomly assigned to anonymous groups of three and one decision is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the panel participation payment whose amount is not specified here. The records do not preserve your presentation position or earlier own choices; do not treat this decision as the first decision or infer that you had no earlier choices. No other item responses are supplied as history. The input gives the current endowment, your reported age, and your reported sex (male or female). No questionnaire score, group outcome or future choice is provided. Output only KEEP, GROUP, or ENV, without explanation.

Choose exactly one destination for your entire endowment: KEEP means keep it for yourself; GROUP means put all of it into the shared group account; ENV means put all of it into the environmental donation account. After everyone chooses, the experimenter doubles the total in the group account and divides it equally among all three members, including anyone who chose KEEP or ENV. The experimenter also doubles the total in the environmental account and donates it to BUND Deutschland, an environmental protection organization; this donation is not paid back to group members. Your payoff for a paid decision is the money you kept plus one third of the doubled group-account total. Keeping money does not double that money. You make ten decisions at endowments from EUR0.20 to EUR2.00 in EUR0.20 steps, presented in random order. After data collection, participants are randomly assigned to anonymous groups of three and one decision is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the panel participation payment whose amount is not specified here. The records do not preserve your presentation position or earlier own choices; do not treat this decision as the first decision or infer that you had no earlier choices. No other item responses are supplied as history. The input gives the current endowment, your reported age, and your reported sex (male or female). No questionnaire score, group outcome or future choice is provided. Output only KEEP, GROUP, or ENV, without explanation.

Choose exactly one destination for your entire endowment: KEEP means keep it for yourself; GROUP means put all of it into the shared group account; ENV means put all of it into the environmental donation account. After everyone chooses, the experimenter doubles the total in the group account and divides it equally among all three members, including anyone who chose KEEP or ENV. The experimenter also doubles the total in the environmental account and donates it to BUND Deutschland, an environmental protection organization; this donation is not paid back to group members. Your payoff for a paid decision is the money you kept plus one third of the doubled group-account total. Keeping money does not double that money. You make ten decisions at endowments from EUR0.20 to EUR2.00 in EUR0.20 steps, presented in random order. After data collection, participants are randomly assigned to anonymous groups of three and one decision is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the panel participation payment whose amount is not specified here. The records do not preserve your presentation position or earlier own choices; do not treat this decision as the first decision or infer that you had no earlier choices. No other item responses are supplied as history. The input gives the current endowment, your reported age, and your reported sex (male or female). No questionnaire score, group outcome or future choice is provided. Output only KEEP, GROUP, or ENV, without explanation.

Choose exactly one destination for your entire endowment: KEEP means keep it for yourself; GROUP means put all of it into the shared group account; ENV means put all of it into the environmental donation account. After everyone chooses, the experimenter doubles the total in the group account and divides it equally among all three members, including anyone who chose KEEP or ENV. The experimenter also doubles the total in the environmental account and donates it to BUND Deutschland, an environmental protection organization; this donation is not paid back to group members. Your payoff for a paid decision is the money you kept plus one third of the doubled group-account total. Keeping money does not double that money. You make ten decisions at endowments from EUR0.20 to EUR2.00 in EUR0.20 steps, presented in random order. After data collection, participants are randomly assigned to anonymous groups of three and one decision is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the panel participation payment whose amount is not specified here. The records do not preserve your presentation position or earlier own choices; do not treat this decision as the first decision or infer that you had no earlier choices. No other item responses are supplied as history. The input gives the current endowment, your reported age, and your reported sex (male or female). No questionnaire score, group outcome or future choice is provided. Output only KEEP, GROUP, or ENV, without explanation.

Choose exactly one destination for your entire endowment: KEEP means keep it for yourself; GROUP means put all of it into the shared group account; ENV means put all of it into the environmental donation account. After everyone chooses, the experimenter doubles the total in the group account and divides it equally among all three members, including anyone who chose KEEP or ENV. The experimenter also doubles the total in the environmental account and donates it to BUND Deutschland, an environmental protection organization; this donation is not paid back to group members. Your payoff for a paid decision is the money you kept plus one third of the doubled group-account total. Keeping money does not double that money. You make ten decisions at endowments from EUR0.20 to EUR2.00 in EUR0.20 steps, presented in random order. After data collection, participants are randomly assigned to anonymous groups of three and one decision is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the panel participation payment whose amount is not specified here. The records do not preserve your presentation position or earlier own choices; do not treat this decision as the first decision or infer that you had no earlier choices. No other item responses are supplied as history. The input gives the current endowment, your reported age, and your reported sex (male or female). No questionnaire score, group outcome or future choice is provided. Output only KEEP, GROUP, or ENV, without explanation.

Choose exactly one destination for your entire endowment: KEEP means keep it for yourself; GROUP means put all of it into the shared group account; ENV means put all of it into the environmental donation account. After everyone chooses, the experimenter doubles the total in the group account and divides it equally among all three members, including anyone who chose KEEP or ENV. The experimenter also doubles the total in the environmental account and donates it to BUND Deutschland, an environmental protection organization; this donation is not paid back to group members. Your payoff for a paid decision is the money you kept plus one third of the doubled group-account total. Keeping money does not double that money. You make ten decisions at endowments from EUR0.20 to EUR2.00 in EUR0.20 steps, presented in random order. After data collection, participants are randomly assigned to anonymous groups of three and one decision is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the panel participation payment whose amount is not specified here. The records do not preserve your presentation position or earlier own choices; do not treat this decision as the first decision or infer that you had no earlier choices. No other item responses are supplied as history. The input gives the current endowment, your reported age, and your reported sex (male or female). No questionnaire score, group outcome or future choice is provided. Output only KEEP, GROUP, or ENV, without explanation.

Choose exactly one destination for your entire endowment: KEEP means keep it for yourself; GROUP means put all of it into the shared group account; ENV means put all of it into the environmental donation account. After everyone chooses, the experimenter doubles the total in the group account and divides it equally among all three members, including anyone who chose KEEP or ENV. The experimenter also doubles the total in the environmental account and donates it to BUND Deutschland, an environmental protection organization; this donation is not paid back to group members. Your payoff for a paid decision is the money you kept plus one third of the doubled group-account total. Keeping money does not double that money. You make ten decisions at endowments from EUR0.20 to EUR2.00 in EUR0.20 steps, presented in random order. After data collection, participants are randomly assigned to anonymous groups of three and one decision is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the panel participation payment whose amount is not specified here. The records do not preserve your presentation position or earlier own choices; do not treat this decision as the first decision or infer that you had no earlier choices. No other item responses are supplied as history. The input gives the current endowment, your reported age, and your reported sex (male or female). No questionnaire score, group outcome or future choice is provided. Output only KEEP, GROUP, or ENV, without explanation.

Choose exactly one destination for your entire endowment: KEEP means keep it for yourself; GROUP means put all of it into the shared group account; ENV means put all of it into the environmental donation account. After everyone chooses, the experimenter doubles the total in the group account and divides it equally among all three members, including anyone who chose KEEP or ENV. The experimenter also doubles the total in the environmental account and donates it to BUND Deutschland, an environmental protection organization; this donation is not paid back to group members. Your payoff for a paid decision is the money you kept plus one third of the doubled group-account total. Keeping money does not double that money. You make ten decisions at endowments from EUR0.20 to EUR2.00 in EUR0.20 steps, presented in random order. After data collection, participants are randomly assigned to anonymous groups of three and one decision is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the panel participation payment whose amount is not specified here. The records do not preserve your presentation position or earlier own choices; do not treat this decision as the first decision or infer that you had no earlier choices. No other item responses are supplied as history. The input gives the current endowment, your reported age, and your reported sex (male or female). No questionnaire score, group outcome or future choice is provided. Output only KEEP, GROUP, or ENV, without explanation.

Choose exactly one destination for your entire endowment: KEEP means keep it for yourself; GROUP means put all of it into the shared group account; ENV means put all of it into the environmental donation account. After everyone chooses, the experimenter doubles the total in the group account and divides it equally among all three members, including anyone who chose KEEP or ENV. The experimenter also doubles the total in the environmental account and donates it to BUND Deutschland, an environmental protection organization; this donation is not paid back to group members. Your payoff for a paid decision is the money you kept plus one third of the doubled group-account total. Keeping money does not double that money. You make ten decisions at endowments from EUR0.20 to EUR2.00 in EUR0.20 steps, presented in random order. After data collection, participants are randomly assigned to anonymous groups of three and one decision is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the panel participation payment whose amount is not specified here. The records do not preserve your presentation position or earlier own choices; do not treat this decision as the first decision or infer that you had no earlier choices. No other item responses are supplied as history. The input gives the current endowment, your reported age, and your reported sex (male or female). No questionnaire score, group outcome or future choice is provided. Output only KEEP, GROUP, or ENV, without explanation.

Choose exactly one destination for your entire endowment: KEEP means keep it for yourself; GROUP means put all of it into the shared group account; ENV means put all of it into the environmental donation account. After everyone chooses, the experimenter doubles the total in the group account and divides it equally among all three members, including anyone who chose KEEP or ENV. The experimenter also doubles the total in the environmental account and donates it to BUND Deutschland, an environmental protection organization; this donation is not paid back to group members. Your payoff for a paid decision is the money you kept plus one third of the doubled group-account total. Keeping money does not double that money. You make ten decisions at endowments from EUR0.20 to EUR2.00 in EUR0.20 steps, presented in random order. After data collection, participants are randomly assigned to anonymous groups of three and one decision is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the panel participation payment whose amount is not specified here. The records do not preserve your presentation position or earlier own choices; do not treat this decision as the first decision or infer that you had no earlier choices. No other item responses are supplied as history. The input gives the current endowment, your reported age, and your reported sex (male or female). No questionnaire score, group outcome or future choice is provided. Output only KEEP, GROUP, or ENV, without explanation.

Choose exactly one destination for your entire endowment: KEEP means keep it for yourself; GROUP means put all of it into the shared group account; ENV means put all of it into the environmental donation account. After everyone chooses, the experimenter doubles the total in the group account and divides it equally among all three members, including anyone who chose KEEP or ENV. The experimenter also doubles the total in the environmental account and donates it to BUND Deutschland, an environmental protection organization; this donation is not paid back to group members. Your payoff for a paid decision is the money you kept plus one third of the doubled group-account total. Keeping money does not double that money. You make ten decisions at endowments from EUR0.20 to EUR2.00 in EUR0.20 steps, presented in random order. After data collection, participants are randomly assigned to anonymous groups of three and one decision is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the panel participation payment whose amount is not specified here. The records do not preserve your presentation position or earlier own choices; do not treat this decision as the first decision or infer that you had no earlier choices. No other item responses are supplied as history. The input gives the current endowment, your reported age, and your reported sex (male or female). No questionnaire score, group outcome or future choice is provided. Output only KEEP, GROUP, or ENV, without explanation.

Choose exactly one destination for your entire endowment: KEEP means keep it for yourself; GROUP means put all of it into the shared group account; ENV means put all of it into the environmental donation account. After everyone chooses, the experimenter doubles the total in the group account and divides it equally among all three members, including anyone who chose KEEP or ENV. The experimenter also doubles the total in the environmental account and donates it to BUND Deutschland, an environmental protection organization; this donation is not paid back to group members. Your payoff for a paid decision is the money you kept plus one third of the doubled group-account total. Keeping money does not double that money. You make ten decisions at endowments from EUR0.20 to EUR2.00 in EUR0.20 steps, presented in random order. After data collection, participants are randomly assigned to anonymous groups of three and one decision is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the panel participation payment whose amount is not specified here. The records do not preserve your presentation position or earlier own choices; do not treat this decision as the first decision or infer that you had no earlier choices. No other item responses are supplied as history. The input gives the current endowment, your reported age, and your reported sex (male or female). No questionnaire score, group outcome or future choice is provided. Output only KEEP, GROUP, or ENV, without explanation.

Choose exactly one destination for your entire endowment: KEEP means keep it for yourself; GROUP means put all of it into the shared group account; ENV means put all of it into the environmental donation account. After everyone chooses, the experimenter doubles the total in the group account and divides it equally among all three members, including anyone who chose KEEP or ENV. The experimenter also doubles the total in the environmental account and donates it to BUND Deutschland, an environmental protection organization; this donation is not paid back to group members. Your payoff for a paid decision is the money you kept plus one third of the doubled group-account total. Keeping money does not double that money. You make ten decisions at endowments from EUR0.20 to EUR2.00 in EUR0.20 steps, presented in random order. After data collection, participants are randomly assigned to anonymous groups of three and one decision is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the panel participation payment whose amount is not specified here. The records do not preserve your presentation position or earlier own choices; do not treat this decision as the first decision or infer that you had no earlier choices. No other item responses are supplied as history. The input gives the current endowment, your reported age, and your reported sex (male or female). No questionnaire score, group outcome or future choice is provided. Output only KEEP, GROUP, or ENV, without explanation.

Choose exactly one destination for your entire endowment: KEEP means keep it for yourself; GROUP means put all of it into the shared group account; ENV means put all of it into the environmental donation account. After everyone chooses, the experimenter doubles the total in the group account and divides it equally among all three members, including anyone who chose KEEP or ENV. The experimenter also doubles the total in the environmental account and donates it to BUND Deutschland, an environmental protection organization; this donation is not paid back to group members. Your payoff for a paid decision is the money you kept plus one third of the doubled group-account total. Keeping money does not double that money. You make ten decisions at endowments from EUR0.20 to EUR2.00 in EUR0.20 steps, presented in random order. After data collection, participants are randomly assigned to anonymous groups of three and one decision is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the panel participation payment whose amount is not specified here. The records do not preserve your presentation position or earlier own choices; do not treat this decision as the first decision or infer that you had no earlier choices. No other item responses are supplied as history. The input gives the current endowment, your reported age, and your reported sex (male or female). No questionnaire score, group outcome or future choice is provided. Output only KEEP, GROUP, or ENV, without explanation.

Choose exactly one destination for your entire endowment: KEEP means keep it for yourself; GROUP means put all of it into the shared group account; ENV means put all of it into the environmental donation account. After everyone chooses, the experimenter doubles the total in the group account and divides it equally among all three members, including anyone who chose KEEP or ENV. The experimenter also doubles the total in the environmental account and donates it to BUND Deutschland, an environmental protection organization; this donation is not paid back to group members. Your payoff for a paid decision is the money you kept plus one third of the doubled group-account total. Keeping money does not double that money. You make ten decisions at endowments from EUR0.20 to EUR2.00 in EUR0.20 steps, presented in random order. After data collection, participants are randomly assigned to anonymous groups of three and one decision is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the panel participation payment whose amount is not specified here. The records do not preserve your presentation position or earlier own choices; do not treat this decision as the first decision or infer that you had no earlier choices. No other item responses are supplied as history. The input gives the current endowment, your reported age, and your reported sex (male or female). No questionnaire score, group outcome or future choice is provided. Output only KEEP, GROUP, or ENV, without explanation.
